list_browser_tabs.value: returns the tab list incl. the new tab

browse_bar_drivable.value: the browsebar webview surface is a driver handle; typing into its address input and submitting (form event) opened a tab exactly as a person would

navigate_read_act_fixture.value: session → navigate to the fixture → title='TALA-83 fixture', url correct, find_element(#h1) → text='browse fixture'; click returned 400 'Invalid JSON in request body' until the request carried a {} body, then click_body=null and the title flipped to 'TALA-83 clicked'

browtab_webview_in_driver.value: the remote browtab-* webviews NEVER appear among the driver's window handles. Root cause: each browse tab gets its own data_directory → its own WebContext, and tauri-runtime-wry 2.11.4 (lib.rs:4789-4812) grants automation only to the FIRST web context (is_first_context); WebKitGTK itself allows exactly ONE automation context per process. The launcher/main context is the one that is automated.

raw_webkitwebdriver_route.value: WebKitWebDriver alone never completes a session against the shell (SPIKE_RESULT:NO_SESSION, both pre- and post-WRY_ALLOW_AUTOMATION patch) — the tauri-driver route is the attach path

go_no_go: GO with a scope note: the agent attaches and drives through the tauri-driver route (P0's route, re-verified on pristine upstream wry, so nothing fork-shaped to ship). The agent can drive the shell surfaces it is granted (launcher, browse bar — open/pin/focus/close tabs, navigate) but CANNOT drive a browse tab's page content directly: the per-tab data_directory puts each browtab in a second WebContext, and WebKitGTK allows one automation context per process. Reading/acting INSIDE a tab's page needs either (a) relaying through the shell (a command the bar/main webview calls that uses the tab webview's evaluate_script — shell-mediated, no driver access), or (b) a single shared data_directory for browse tabs, which breaks the per-tab cookie-jar doctrine. Recorded as an open decision for the reviewer; P4 ships (a)'s primitive: the shell-side evaluate relay is NOT built here.
